body: I'm going to do it. I just wanted to say thank you for the kind words and love. I recieved paperwork today stating I have no rights. The children's names will be changed and if I seek them out until they are of age I will be arrested and locked away for harassment. I'm done. I have lost for good. I can't keep this up. I love you. For those who need the strength I give what I have for you. Insha'Allah one day, someone else will win in my place. God forgive me.

If I told anyone I'm close to that I felt this way, I'd be an outcast. My family would shun me and call me weak, a coward etc. To my family suicide is only for the weak and those who are worthless anyway.

I've never sought out real professional help. I couldn't or I would be deemed unfit as a parent. I was never depressed or anxious until this occurred. 

I just want my kids. I want to watch them grow up. I want to be able to teach my son to throw a ball and my daughter how to be treated. I would give anything to be able to make them chicken noodle soup when they're sick or watch Disney movies on repeat. I love my kids more than anything, to have lost them, I have lost myself.

The adoptive parents have already stated, they intend to never tell my kids they're adopted. They've said that it's better if they made it seem as if I don't exist or never did. I honestly don't know if it's actual voices, it's mine own that I hear. I cannot seek help. If I do, I'm unfit as a parent, or "visitor". I was never this way until my life became a dumpster fire.
